en.summary: OpenCove 0.4.0 introduces Pixel themes, a more flexible canvas, and independently installed plugins and themes, with improvements to terminal links and Agent recovery.

items.summary: Choose Pixel or Pixel Light, customize window colors, and control pixel effects for the canvas, windows and Agent activity.
Collapse windows into compact desktop icons, restore them with smooth motion, and keep their collapsed state across restarts.
Create windows by clicking the canvas toolbar or dragging a creation button directly to the desired position.
Browse folders in icon or tree views, navigate with breadcrumbs, and drag files or folders onto the canvas as windows.
Navigate projects from a compact rail, reveal projects on hover, pin or hide Spaces and Agents, and switch projects with keyboard shortcuts.
Manage appearance, Agent ordering and connections in a redesigned main-area Settings page with live theme previews.
Install independent plugins from local folders or Git repositories to add canvas windows, commands, packaged Skills and Sidebar tools.
Preview plugins, manage visibility, reloads and Git updates with code rollback, and read plugin documentation and guides from Settings or the CLI.
Extend built-in themes with custom component skins, images, fonts and visual effects across Desktop and Web, while preserving appearance and motion preferences.
Follow wrapped terminal links correctly, preview linked images in file windows with audio/video playback preserved, and open unsupported files in the system app.
Restore Pi session listing and switching, copy the latest assistant reply, and return to the correct session after recovery.
Restore terminal startup when launch files are missing or damaged, and handle Unicode profile and runtime paths in Windows Agent launches.

zh-CN.summary: OpenCove 0.4.0 带来 Pixel 双主题、更灵活的画布，以及可独立安装的插件与主题，并改善终端链接和 Agent 会话恢复。

items.summary: 选择 Pixel 或 Pixel Light 主题，自定义窗口配色，并控制画布、窗口和 Agent 活动的像素效果。
将窗口折叠为紧凑的桌面图标，以平滑动画恢复，并在重启后保留折叠状态。
点击画布工具栏创建窗口，或将创建按钮直接拖到希望放置的位置。
以图标或树形视图浏览文件夹，使用面包屑导航，并将文件或文件夹拖到画布上成为独立窗口。
通过紧凑的项目栏导航，悬停展开项目，置顶或隐藏 Space 与 Agent，并使用快捷键切换项目。
在重新设计的主区域设置页面中管理外观、Agent 排序和连接，并实时预览主题效果。
从本地文件夹或 Git 仓库独立安装插件，为工作区添加画布窗口、命令、随包提供的 Skills 和侧边栏工具。
预览插件，管理入口可见性、重新加载和 Git 更新，支持代码回滚，并从设置或 CLI 阅读插件文档与指南。
在内置主题基础上扩展组件皮肤、图片、字体和视觉效果，同步用于 Desktop 与 Web，并保留个人外观和动效偏好。
正确打开换行的终端链接，在文件窗口预览图片并保留音视频播放，不支持的格式可交给系统应用打开。
恢复 Pi 会话列表与切换、复制最近助手回复，并在恢复后定位到正确会话。
修复启动文件缺失或损坏时的终端启动，并让 Windows Agent 正确处理包含 Unicode 字符的用户配置与运行时路径。
